entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They seriously gonna be able to[n]pull this off?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: She was sayin' stuff like, "I'll just[n]seduce him with my acting," but[n]that sounds out of her league...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Plus we ain't got one sign this place is[n]gonna open... Isn't Madarame comin'[n]home soon?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: On top of that, even if Mona's able to[n]unlock the door, how's he gonna[n]show it to Madarame?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: And then even if they do show it open,[n]any normal person'd just close it right up[n]again.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Doesn't that mean we only got[n]a few seconds to get in?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: To be blunt, won't it be a miracle if[n]this works?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I wanna think that too, but...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So it IS gonna be a miracle!
